basis: BEA: "Crude pipelines margins go to any crude oil commodity." At BEA 2017 detail crude oil and natural gas are a single commodity, so 4861 and 4862 land on the same code and their split does not affect the allocation.
BEA: "Natural gas pipelines margins go to natural gas commodity." 221200 natural gas distribution is the utility, not the commodity, and receives no TRANS in 2017 - do not map here.

sas_description: Pipeline transportation of refined petroleum products
basis: BEA: "Refined petroleum margins go to refined fuels such as gasoline, jet fuel, kerosene and other refined oils and waxes." 324110 is gasoline, jet fuel and kerosene.

sas_description: Pipeline transportation of refined petroleum products
bea_2017_description: Other petroleum and coal products manufacturing
basis: The "other refined oils and waxes" half of BEA's list. Excluded deliberately: 324121 asphalt paving mixture and 324122 asphalt shingles, which are refinery products but are not moved by pipeline.
BEA: "Pipeline, NEC margins are applied to dyes, pigments, toners, ammonia, Urea and like products that would be transported through a pipeline." This is the dyes and pigments term.
The toners term of BEA's NEC list.
The ammonia and urea term of BEA's NEC list; both are nitrogenous fertilizer products rolling up to 325310.
